body:
Two founder-directed follow-ups on the training pipeline:

1. "we need to implement fast forward just like brawlpit" -- found BRAWLPIT's
own rl_train_packet.py hardcodes --fast-forward unconditionally. Flipped
SHANKPIT's own default from False to True in rl_train_packet.py and
colab_train.py (kept as an overridable --no-fast-forward). Live-verified:
~30fps -> ~107fps, no hang.

2. "give us the survival streak bonus" (following a question about whether
the pipeline was event-driven with discounted reward over time) -- direct
port of BRAWLPIT's own Fibonacci-scaled survival-streak reward tier
(already carrying BRAWLPIT's own real bug fix: stops paying past the cap,
doesn't just clamp there), into both scripts/rl_env_packet.py and
apps2/emily-bot/reward.go. Adapted BRAWLPIT's damage-percent scaling to
SHANKPIT's own health-based (100->0) equivalent. 8 new tests total, all
passing.

Commits: SHANKPIT@91e6090, SHANKPIT@8002c00.

⚓ ☃
title: S459-51: fast-forward default flip + survival-streak reward bonus, both ported from BRAWLPIT
